ex: The test was a piece of cake.
exAr: كان الامتحان سهلًا جدًا.

ex: I can't make up my mind which dress to buy.
exAr: لا أستطيع أن أقرر أي فستان أشتري.

ex: I was going to stay, but I changed my mind.
exAr: كنت سأبقى، لكنني غيّرت رأيي.

ex: Keep in mind that the shop closes at six.
exAr: ضع في اعتبارك أن المتجر يغلق في السادسة.

ex: You've been ill, so take it easy this week.
exAr: كنت مريضًا، لذا ارتح هذا الأسبوع.

ex: Can you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
exTr: Bir dakika çantama göz kulak olur musun?
exAr: هل يمكنك مراقبة حقيبتي لدقيقة؟

ex: Driving is hard at first, but you'll get the hang of it.
exTr: Araba sürmek ilk başta zor ama alışırsın.
exAr: القيادة صعبة في البداية، لكنك ستتقنها.

d: make people feel relaxed when they first meet
ex: He told a joke to break the ice.
exTr: Buzları eritmek için bir şaka yaptı.
exAr: ألقى نكتة ليكسر الجليد.

ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
exAr: أشعر بتوعك قليلًا اليوم.

ex: It's seven o'clock. Let's call it a day.
exTr: Saat yedi. Bugünlük bu kadar diyelim.
exAr: الساعة السابعة. لننهِ العمل لهذا اليوم.

ex: Before we start, let's make sure we're on the same page.
exTr: Başlamadan önce aynı fikirde olduğumuzdan emin olalım.
exAr: قبل أن نبدأ، لنتأكد أننا متفقون.

ex: She called me out of the blue after ten years.
exTr: On yıl sonra durup dururken beni aradı.
exAr: اتصلت بي فجأة بعد عشر سنوات.

d: the final problem that makes you lose patience
ex: He was late again. That was the last straw.
exTr: Yine geç kaldı. Bu bardağı taşıran son damlaydı.
exAr: تأخر مرة أخرى. كانت تلك القشة التي قصمت ظهر البعير.

ex: Don't make such a big deal out of it.
exAr: لا تجعل منها مشكلة كبيرة.

# w: it's not the end of the world
d: it is not as bad as it seems
ex: You failed one test. It's not the end of the world.
exTr: Bir sınavdan kaldın. Dünyanın sonu değil.
exAr: رسبت في امتحان واحد. ليست نهاية العالم.

d: it is better to do something late than not at all
ex: You finally called! Better late than never.
ar: أن تأتي متأخرًا خير من ألا تأتي
exTr: Sonunda aradın! Geç olsun güç olmasın.
exAr: اتصلت أخيرًا! أن تأتي متأخرًا خير من ألا تأتي.

ex: It's late. We should hit the road.
exAr: تأخر الوقت. يجب أن ننطلق.

ex: That noise is getting on my nerves.
exAr: هذا الضجيج يثير أعصابي.

ex: Don't worry, we're all in the same boat.
exAr: لا تقلق، كلنا في القارب نفسه.

ex: I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
exTr: Kırk yılda bir fast food yerim.
exAr: آكل الوجبات السريعة نادرًا جدًا.

# w: cost an arm and a leg
ex: That watch must have cost an arm and a leg.
exTr: O saat bir servete mal olmuş olmalı.
exAr: لا بد أن تلك الساعة كلّفت ثروة.

# w: on the tip of my tongue
ex: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
exAr: اسمه على طرف لساني.

d: something that seems bad but is good
ex: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
exTr: O işi kaybetmek aslında hayırlı oldu.
exAr: كان فقدان تلك الوظيفة نعمة في ثوب نقمة.

# w: let the cat out of the bag
ex: Who let the cat out of the bag about the party?
exTr: Parti hakkında baklayı kim ağzından çıkardı?
exAr: من أفشى سرّ الحفلة؟

# w: kill two birds with one stone
d: do two things with one action
ex: I'll kill two birds with one stone and shop on the way.
exTr: Yolda alışveriş yapıp bir taşla iki kuş vuracağım.
exAr: سأضرب عصفورين بحجر واحد وأتسوق في الطريق.

ex: My brother and I don't always see eye to eye.
exTr: Kardeşimle her zaman aynı fikirde değiliz.
exAr: أنا وأخي لا نتفق دائمًا.

# w: the ball is in your court
d: it is your turn to act or decide
ex: I've made my offer. The ball is in your court.
exAr: قدّمت عرضي. الكرة الآن في ملعبك.

# w: hit the nail on the head
ex: You hit the nail on the head: we need more staff.
exTr: Tam üstüne bastın: daha fazla personele ihtiyacımız var.
exAr: أصبت كبد الحقيقة: نحتاج إلى موظفين أكثر.

ex: He'll clean his room. "Yes, when pigs fly."
exAr: سيرتب غرفته. "نعم، في المشمش."

d: easy to talk about but hard to do
ex: Stop worrying? That's easier said than done.
exAr: أتوقف عن القلق؟ القول أسهل من الفعل.

ex: The party got out of hand and the police came.
exTr: Parti kontrolden çıktı ve polis geldi.
exAr: خرجت الحفلة عن السيطرة وجاءت الشرطة.

ex: Keep your fingers crossed for my interview!
exAr: تمنَّ لي الحظ في مقابلتي!

ex: She was over the moon about the news.
exAr: طارت من الفرح بالخبر.

ex: I've been feeling a bit down lately.
exAr: أشعر ببعض الإحباط مؤخرًا.

d: do more than you need to
ex: The staff went the extra mile to help us.
tr: fazlasını yapmak, elinden geleni fazlasıyla yapmak
exTr: Personel bize yardım etmek için fazlasıyla çaba gösterdi.
exAr: بذل الموظفون جهدًا إضافيًا لمساعدتنا.

d: learn how to do a job
ex: It takes a few weeks to learn the ropes here.
exTr: Burada işin inceliklerini öğrenmek birkaç hafta sürer.
exAr: يستغرق تعلّم أصول العمل هنا بضعة أسابيع.

ex: With three kids, I'm always on the go.
exAr: مع ثلاثة أطفال، أنا دائم الانشغال.

ex: Our holiday plans are still up in the air.
exAr: خطط عطلتنا لم تُحسم بعد.

ex: He's in hot water for missing the meeting.
exAr: إنه في ورطة لأنه فوّت الاجتماع.

ex: Filling in these forms is a pain in the neck.
exTr: Bu formları doldurmak tam bir baş belası.
exAr: ملء هذه الاستمارات أمر مزعج جدًا.

ex: Don't answer now. Sleep on it.
exTr: Şimdi cevap verme. Bir gece düşün.
exAr: لا تجب الآن. فكّر فيه حتى الغد.

d: the advantages of two different things
ex: Working from home two days a week gives me the best of both worlds.
exTr: Haftada iki gün evden çalışmak bana iki tarafın da avantajını veriyor.
exAr: العمل من البيت يومين في الأسبوع يمنحني أفضل ما في الأمرين.

# w: by the skin of your teeth
ex: I passed the exam by the skin of my teeth.
exAr: نجحت في الامتحان بشق الأنفس.

d: do something cheaply or badly to save time or money
ex: Don't cut corners on safety.
exAr: لا تتهاون في أمور السلامة.

d: lose a chance by being too slow
ex: The tickets sold out. We missed the boat.
exAr: نفدت التذاكر. فاتتنا الفرصة.

d: joke with someone by telling them something untrue
ex: Relax, I'm just pulling your leg.
exAr: اهدأ، أنا أمازحك فقط.

d: decide what to do as things happen
ex: Let's not plan too much. We'll play it by ear.
exTr: Çok plan yapmayalım. Duruma göre hareket ederiz.
exAr: لا نخطط كثيرًا. سنتصرف حسب الظروف.

ex: She always speaks her mind.
exAr: هي دائمًا تقول رأيها بصراحة.

ex: I was reading and lost track of time.
exTr: Kitap okuyordum ve zamanın nasıl geçtiğini anlamadım.
exAr: كنت أقرأ وفقدت الإحساس بالوقت.

ex: Sorry, I'm running late. See you at ten.
exAr: آسف، أنا متأخر. أراك في العاشرة.

ex: On the bright side, it didn't rain.
exTr: İşin iyi tarafından bakarsak yağmur yağmadı.
exAr: من الجانب المشرق، لم تمطر.

# w: it's not my cup of tea
d: it is not something I like
ex: Opera is not my cup of tea.
exAr: الأوبرا ليست من اهتماماتي.

d: have just enough money to live
ex: It's hard to make ends meet on one salary.
exTr: Tek maaşla iki yakayı bir araya getirmek zor.
exAr: من الصعب تدبير المعيشة براتب واحد.

d: a very small amount compared with what is needed
ex: Ten euros is a drop in the ocean, but it helps.
exTr: On avro devede kulak ama yine de yardımcı olur.
exAr: عشرة يورو قطرة في بحر، لكنها تساعد.

ex: They talk about her behind her back.
exAr: يتحدثون عنها من وراء ظهرها.

d: accept the bad result of your actions
ex: He made the mistake; now he must face the music.
exTr: Hatayı o yaptı, şimdi sonuçlarına katlanmalı.
exAr: هو من أخطأ، والآن عليه أن يواجه العواقب.

ex: Can you give me a hand with these boxes?
exAr: هل يمكنك مساعدتي في حمل هذه الصناديق؟

ex: I've never skied, but I'd like to have a go.
exTr: Hiç kayak yapmadım ama bir denemek isterim.
exAr: لم أتزلج قط، لكنني أودّ أن أجرّب.

ex: Let's keep in touch after the course.
exAr: لنبقَ على تواصل بعد الدورة.

ex: He lost his temper and shouted at everyone.
exAr: فقد أعصابه وصرخ في وجه الجميع.

d: complain or worry too much about something small
ex: Don't make a fuss; it's only a scratch.
exAr: لا تثر ضجة، إنه مجرد خدش.

d: I am not angry with you
ex: You won the game fairly. No hard feelings.
exAr: فزت باللعبة بإنصاف. لا ضغينة.

ex: Going out tonight is out of the question.
exTr: Bu akşam dışarı çıkmak söz konusu bile değil.
exAr: الخروج الليلة غير وارد.

ex: The decorations were a bit over the top.
exAr: كانت الزينة مبالغًا فيها قليلًا.

ex: After work I just want to put my feet up.
exTr: İşten sonra sadece ayaklarımı uzatıp dinlenmek istiyorum.
exAr: بعد العمل أريد فقط أن أسترخي.

ex: His name rings a bell.
exAr: اسمه يبدو مألوفًا.

d: keep money for a future need
ex: I try to save a little for a rainy day.
exTr: Kara gün için biraz para biriktirmeye çalışıyorum.
exAr: أحاول أن أدّخر القليل للأيام الصعبة.

d: not value something because you always have it
ex: We take clean water for granted.
exAr: نعتبر الماء النظيف أمرًا مسلّمًا به.

ex: When should I send it? "The sooner the better."
tr: ne kadar erken o kadar iyi
exTr: Ne zaman göndereyim? "Ne kadar erken o kadar iyi."
exAr: متى أرسله؟ "كلما كان أسرع كان أفضل."

ex: After three tries, he threw in the towel.
exAr: بعد ثلاث محاولات، استسلم.

# w: to make a long story short
ex: To make a long story short, we missed the plane.
exAr: باختصار، فاتتنا الطائرة.

ex: OK, you've twisted my arm. I'll come.
exAr: حسنًا، أقنعتني. سآتي.

d: what are you thinking or worried about
ex: You look quiet. What's on your mind?
exAr: تبدو صامتًا. ما الذي يشغل بالك؟

ex: The restaurant became popular by word of mouth.
exAr: اشتهر المطعم بتناقل الناس لأخباره.

ex: It's so hot today. "You can say that again!"
exAr: الجو حار جدًا اليوم. "معك حق تمامًا!"

d: what you do matters more than what you say
ex: Don't promise; show me. Actions speak louder than words.
exTr: Söz verme, göster. Söz değil iş önemli.
exAr: لا تعِد، بل أرني. الأفعال أبلغ من الأقوال.

d: you improve by doing something many times
ex: Keep speaking every day. Practice makes perfect.
exTr: Her gün konuşmaya devam et. Pratik mükemmelleştirir.
exAr: واصل التحدث كل يوم. التمرين يصنع الإتقان.

d: you must work hard to get results
ex: The training is hard, but no pain, no gain.
exTr: Antrenman zor ama emek olmadan yemek olmaz.
exAr: التدريب صعب، لكن لا نجاح بلا تعب.

d: it is wiser to be careful
ex: Take a coat. Better safe than sorry.
exTr: Bir mont al. Tedbiri elden bırakmamak iyidir.
exAr: خذ معطفًا. الحيطة أفضل من الندم.

ex: Is it already midnight? Time flies!
exTr: Gece yarısı mı oldu? Zaman su gibi akıyor!
exAr: هل أصبحت منتصف الليل؟ الوقت يمر بسرعة!

# w: every cloud has a silver lining
d: something good can come from a bad situation
ex: I lost my job, but every cloud has a silver lining.
exTr: İşimi kaybettim ama her işte bir hayır vardır.
exAr: فقدت وظيفتي، لكن في كل محنة منحة.

# w: don't judge a book by its cover
ex: The café looks old, but don't judge a book by its cover.
ar: لا تحكم على الكتاب من غلافه
exTr: Kafe eski görünüyor ama görünüşe aldanma.
exAr: المقهى يبدو قديمًا، لكن لا تحكم على الكتاب من غلافه.

# w: the early bird catches the worm
ex: I go to the market at seven. The early bird catches the worm!
ar: من جدّ وجد، الطائر المبكر يلتقط الدودة
exTr: Pazara yedide giderim. Erken kalkan yol alır!
exAr: أذهب إلى السوق في السابعة. الطائر المبكر يلتقط الدودة!

# w: two heads are better than one
d: two people solve problems better than one
ex: Let's do it together. Two heads are better than one.
tr: bir elin nesi var, iki elin sesi var
exTr: Birlikte yapalım. Bir elin nesi var, iki elin sesi var.
exAr: لنفعلها معًا. رأيان أفضل من رأي واحد.

d: a lot of work or problems to deal with
ex: I can't help this week; I've got a lot on my plate.
exTr: Bu hafta yardım edemem, başımda çok iş var.
exAr: لا أستطيع المساعدة هذا الأسبوع، لديّ الكثير من المشاغل.

d: become nervous and not want to do something planned
ex: He got cold feet before the wedding.
exTr: Düğünden önce son anda cesareti kırıldı.
exAr: تراجع خوفًا قبل الزفاف.

ex: It's hard now, but hang in there.
exAr: الأمر صعب الآن، لكن اصمد.

ex: You cook, I'll wash up. "It's a deal."
exAr: أنت تطبخ وأنا أغسل الصحون. "اتفقنا."

ex: In the exam my mind went blank.
exAr: في الامتحان صار ذهني فارغًا.

d: not wanting to do something now
ex: I'm not in the mood for a party.
exAr: لست في مزاج للحفلة.
